How we check venues

Every listing is checked against the venue's own website (and occasionally a reputable local guide), with the source linked on the page and a "last checked" date. If we couldn't confirm something, we say Unknown rather than guess. We list places you can book or walk into as an individual: no private-rental-only spots, gyms, or infrared-only studios.

New cities are added regularly.
